verses.1: In the seventh year, on the twentieth day of the month, people from Israel came to ask for guidance from Jehovah. They sat down before Him.
verses.2: And the word of Jehovah was spoken to me.
verses.3: Man said to the elders of Israel, “Say this to them: ‘Thus says the Lord God: I will give you life. If I ask you for a sacrifice, then offer it to Me.’”
verses.4: He will punish them; the son of man will take away the sins of their ancestors from them.
verses.5: And you said to them, “Thus says the Lord God: On the day of your choosing Israel, I will stretch out my hand over the descendants of Jacob. I will know them in the land of Egypt. I will stretch out my hand to them and say, ‘I am the Lord your God.’”
verses.6: On that day, I raised my hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had promised them: a land where there will be milk and goat’s cheese for all the people.
verses.7: And I said to them, “Let those who are blind in their eyes put away their blindness. Do not cover yourselves with the shame of Egypt. I, the LORD your God, will surely do so.”
verses.8: And they refused to listen to me. No one listened to me. They did not throw away the dross from their eyes. They also did not abandon the remnants of Egypt. I said, “Let my anger be poured out upon them, so that I may destroy them completely in the land of Egypt.”
verses.9: And I will do this so that my name may not be known by the nations who are among them. I will make it clear to them, so that they can be brought out of Egypt.
verses.10: And I will bring them out of the land of Egypt, and I will lead them into the desert.
verses.11: And I will give them my laws and judgments. I know those laws and judgments that people should follow in order to live properly.
verses.12: And I also gave them their Sabbaths, so that they could be a reminder of me and between them. This was so that they would know that I, the LORD, am who sanctifies them.
verses.13: And the house of Israel went astray in the desert, without following my laws. They violated my judgments, which are meant to be followed by people so that they may live. They also desecrated my sacrifices. I said, “I will pour out my anger on them in the desert, for their sins.”
verses.14: And I will do this so that my name may not be known by those nations who have set out to destroy me.
verses.15: And I also stretched out my hand to them in the desert, so that I would not bring them into the land that I had given as a gift: milk and goat’s grass for all the nations.
verses.16: Because they did not follow my laws and commandments. They also violated my rules. They broke their promises, because their hearts were filled with evil.
verses.17: And I covered my eyes with my hands, so that I wouldn’t see them. I didn’t destroy them in the field at all.
verses.18: And he said to their children by the sea, “Do not go along with the ways of your ancestors. Do not follow their laws. And do not cover their sins.”
verses.19: I, Jehovah your God, am your law. Go forth according to my laws, and keep and carry out my judgments.
verses.20: And my Sabbaths were sanctified; they became holy days between me and you, so that you would know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.21: And their children did not follow my laws. They did not keep my judgments. They did not do what people should do. They lived in sin. They broke my laws. They said, “Let me pour out my wrath on them in the wilderness.”
verses.22: And I will take my hands back, so that my name may no longer be seen by the nations who brought me forth before their eyes.
verses.23: I also raised my hand to them in the sea, in order to spread them out across the nations and to show them the lands.
verses.24: For they did not obey my laws and ordinances. They violated my commandments. They also desecrated my Sabbaths. After their ancestors’ sins, their eyes became blind.
verses.25: And I also gave them laws that are not good, and judgments that will not be obeyed.
verses.26: And I will close them in their “gifts,” so that every ounce of compassion is lost. So that they may not know what I am, who am I, the LORD.
verses.27: Therefore, I speak to the house of Israel, the descendants of Adam. I say to them, “Oh Lord Jehovah, once again, your ancestors provoked me in this matter. They acted against me.”
verses.28: And I will bring them to the land that I took by force. They will see all those high mountains and all those tall trees. There, they will offer their sacrifices. They will also give gifts as offerings. They will spread their fragrant spices there. And they will cook their offerings there.
verses.29: And he said to them, “What is the name of that place where you are going? Its name has been mentioned ever since that day.”
verses.30: Therefore, say to the house of Israel: “Thus says the Lord God: You will be buried and mourned by your ancestors. But after their deaths, you will be destroyed.”
verses.31: And when you offer your sacrifices, through your children in the fire, then you will be remembered forever among all your descendants. I demand that you come to Israel. I say, “O Lord God, if I demand this from you…”
verses.32: And it would not be so that you would say, “We will become like the nations, who serve trees and stones.”
verses.33: May the Lord, the God of Israel, protect you with His strength, and may He also grant you courage and determination. May He rule over you with His authority.
verses.34: And I have brought you out from among the nations, and I have gathered you together from all the lands where you were scattered by strength and violence and fierce anger.
verses.35: And I will bring you to the land of the nations, and there I will judge you face to face.
verses.36: Just as I judged your ancestors in the land of Egypt, so also I will judge you. Now, O LORD God, judge you according to your deeds.
verses.37: And I have led you under the throne, and I have brought you into the tent of the covenant.
verses.38: And I will remove those who are rebellious and wicked from their land. I will bring them out of their homes and send them to the land of Israel. They shall not enter there. And you shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.39: And you, house of Israel, hear this: “Oh Lord Jehovah says, ‘Let every man go and serve.’ But if you do not listen to me, then do not defile my holy name even during your sacrifices and offerings.”
verses.40: For in the Holy Mountain, in the mountain of Merom, Israel’s God will speak to me. All houses of Israel will worship me there. They will live there, and they will bring their offerings and their firstborn sons as sacrifices in all their rituals.
verses.41: In my anger, I will take you out from among the nations. I will gather you from all the lands where you are scattered. And I will make you holy before the eyes of the nations.
verses.42: Know that I, Jehovah, will bring you back to the land of Israel, to the land that I set my hand to give to your ancestors.
verses.43: And remember there your ways, and all your deceitful schemes that you used against others. Remember also all the evil deeds you committed in front of them.
verses.44: Know that I, Jehovah, am doing these things for your sake, so that My name may not be associated with your evil deeds and with those who are slandering you in Israel. May the Lord say this!
